I re-derived the schedule and checked every constraint, and it is the only valid one.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Gus","2":"Dev","3":"Ann","4":"Cara","5":"Elif","6":"Ben","7":"Finn","8":"Hana","9":"Ivo"}
CONFIDENCE: 98

Key steps: Hana = Finn + 1, and Cara, Elif, and Ann all come before Finn. Ben must be two slots from both Hana and Cara, which forces Ben = Finn − 1 and Cara = Finn − 3. Ivo must then sit at Finn + 2 or later, so Finn is at most 7. Checking Finn = 5, 6, and 7 leaves only Finn = 7, which gives Ivo = 9, Gus = 1, Elif = 5, Ann = 3, and Dev = 2.
